map.回转半径（r = √(I / A)） 使用指南: Radius of Gyration (r = sqrt(I / A)) User Guide
map.输入截面对某轴的惯性矩 I 与截面积 A，计算回转半径 r=√(I/A)，反映截: Enter the moment of inertia I about an axis and the cross-sectional area A to compute the radius of gyration r = sqrt(I/A), which reflects how far the area is distributed from the centroid and is used to solve slenderness ratios in compression member stability calculations.
map.回转半径反映截面面积分布离形心的远近。: The radius of gyration reflects how far the cross-sectional area is distributed from the centroid.
map.压杆长细比计算中的几何参数。: Geometric parameter used in calculating the slenderness ratio of a compression member.
map.截面紧凑性评定（防局部失稳）。: Cross-section compactness rating (guards against local instability).
map.与欧拉屈曲、稳定系数联动。: Links with Euler buckling and the stability factor.
map.：A 1e-3→2e-3（I 不变）：r 降为 22.4 mm。: A 1e-3 -> 2e-3 (I unchanged): r drops to 22.4 mm.
map.长细比怎么算？: How Is the Slenderness Ratio Computed?
map.λ=L/r，r 越大越不易屈曲；细长柱 λ 大、稳定性差。: lambda = L/r, so a larger r makes buckling less likely; slender columns have large lambda and poor stability.
map.等价于惯性矩折算成的等效截面半径，反映质量分布离轴远近。: Equivalent to an effective section radius converted from the moment of inertia, reflecting how far the mass is distributed from the axis.
